messages.text: for my sky-100,I tested what you asked me to do; after charging it a bit more, it went back to normal for a day, but I tried taking it apart and removing the battery—to no avail—the result is still the same.
I'll check our reference notes first.

Quick check on the model name before I answer.
Searched the web · "Sky-100" miner device battery HeliumDeploy

Hi, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Thanks for running those tests.

Two quick things:

1. Please leave the Sky-100 connected to its charger and keep it connected for the whole test. Tell me whether the fault is still there while it is plugged in and charging, or whether it behaves normally as long as the cable is attached. That one answer separates a tired battery cell from a fault on the board itself.

2. So I describe the right thing to our hardware lead, tell me exactly what it does now: the LED colour and blink pattern, anything on the screen, and what the SkyX app shows for the station (online, offline, last data point).

A short video of the unit from the moment you press power, plus a photo of the serial label, would help a lot.

One note so there is no surprise later: opening the housing and pulling the battery is the kind of thing that can affect warranty cover, so please leave it closed from here on and let me do the next checks with you.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Searched the web · SkyX Sky-100 app temperature 9999 humidity 9999 sensor readi

Thanks, that screenshot tells me a lot. I see the dashboard for your station "(address hidden)": temperature 9999.0 °C, humidity 9999.0 %, wind average 0.0 m/s, and pressure 1013.8 hPa.

What that means: 9999 is not a real measurement. In weather data a value like 9999 is the placeholder a logger sends when the sensor gives no valid reading, so the temperature and humidity sensor is not answering. I could not find an official SkyX page that documents that exact value, so I am describing the general convention, not a SkyX spec. The pressure reading of 1013.8 hPa is believable, so the radio link and the board are alive and reporting; it is the temp and humidity channel that is out.

That matches what you saw: right after a charge it reported real values for a day, then dropped back to 9999.

Two things from you, please:

1. The firmware version of the Sky-100, in the app under Devices, plus whether the app itself offers an update for the station.
2. Charge it to full, leave the charger connected, then power cycle it and watch the dashboard for about 15 minutes. Tell me whether temperature and humidity come back to real numbers while it is on the charger, and if they do, roughly what battery level they flip back to 9999 at.

If it reads correctly only on a full battery and fails again as the charge drops, that points at the sensor power rail on the board rather than anything you can fix with a setting, and I will take it from there with our hardware lead.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Used rma verdict

I opened that one too. It shows the app's Problem Diagnosis screen: "Connecting to device" with a green check, "Diagnosing device" still spinning, and the error "Device Diagnostic Failed. Diagnosis failed. Please try again. TimeoutException after 0:00:30.000000: Future not completed".

How I read it: the phone reaches the station fine, so Bluetooth and pairing are good. The station then never sends its diagnostic result back inside the app's 30 second window. That fits the dashboard picture, where the sensor channel sits at 9999 while pressure still reports. The sensor read is hanging, and the diagnostic routine waits on the same read.

Worth retrying once in better conditions, because a timeout can also be a dropped Bluetooth packet:

1. Phone within about one metre of the station, charger connected, nothing else paired to the station, then run Problem Diagnosis twice in a row. Tell me if it ever completes.
2. I still need the firmware version from the app under Devices, and whether the app offers an update for the station.
3. And the result of the full charge test: do temperature and humidity come back to real numbers on a full battery with the charger plugged in.

Send those three and I will have what I need to put this in front of JD, our hardware lead, with a full picture.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Searched the web · SkyX SKY-100 firmware revision 25.02266 update

Got it, I opened it. Device Details shows: Sky-Purdey, SKY-100, seen 4 minutes ago, Battery 45%, Status Online, Last Observation 2026-11-03 19:35, Online time 10 hours, Signal Fair, Disaster status Safe, Firmware Revision 25.02266.

Useful news in there: the station is genuinely online and still uploading observations, so the radio, the battery and the link are doing their job. The problem is narrowed down to the measurement side, the same thing that makes the diagnosis hang.

On firmware: I could not find a public SkyX changelog that tells me what the newest revision is, so I will not guess. The app is the source of truth here.

Two last checks, then I hand this to JD with everything:

1. In Device Details, tap About and tell me if it offers a firmware update for 25.02266. If it does, run it with the charger connected and do not interrupt it.
2. Charge to 100%, keep the charger plugged in, then open Environment Data and tell me what temperature and humidity read. Right now you are at 45%, which is below the level where it last worked.

If a full battery brings the real readings back and 45% does not, that is a power rail problem on the board, not something a setting can fix. Same conclusion if the update is available, installs cleanly and the readings stay at 9999.

it's not possible to send video
only photo

No problem at all, photos are plenty for this one. Nothing here needs a video.

Just two screenshots when you can:

1. Device Details, tap About, so I can see whether a firmware update is offered for 25.02266. If one is offered, run it with the charger connected.
2. After a full charge, charger still plugged in, the Environment Data screen showing temperature and humidity.

Take your time with the charge, I will be here when you have the second one.
Hal demand a video

That was me, in my first message, and I am withdrawing it. No video needed. The screenshots you already sent told me more than a video would have.

To be clear about what is still open, only these two, both photos:

1. Device Details, About: does it offer a firmware update for 25.02266.
2. After a full charge with the charger still connected: the Environment Data screen with temperature and humidity.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

I opened it. Same Device Details screen, now: Battery 57% (so it is charging, up from 45%), Status Online, Last Observation 20:40, Online time 12 hours, Signal Weak, Firmware Revision still 25.02266.

One small thing to note: signal went from Fair to Weak between the two screenshots. That does not cause 9999 readings, but it is worth moving the station closer to your gateway or window later on.

Still the two I need, from this same screen:

1. Scroll to the bottom and tap About. Photo of that screen, so I can see whether a firmware update is offered for 25.02266.
2. Once it reaches 100%, charger still plugged in, tap Environment Data and send me that screen with temperature and humidity.
You can see from this when it changed.

I only have the Device Details screenshot on my side, and that one does not show a history, just the current state. If a second image was attached it did not reach me.

The screen that shows when it changed is "History Environment Data", one row below Environment Data. Please open that and send me a photo covering the period where the values flipped back to 9999, ideally with the timestamps visible. If it lets you pick a range, the last 7 days is perfect.

That history plus the About screen is the last piece, then I take it to JD.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

That history is the most useful thing you have sent. Reading it from the bottom up:

- 14:42 temp 8.8, humidity 80
- 14:47 temp 8.3, humidity 80
- 14:57 temp 9999, humidity 9999
- 15:12 temp 8.2, humidity 74
- 15:23 temp 9999, humidity 9999
- 15:38 temp 9999, humidity 9999

Pressure stays correct through all of it, around 1011.5 to 1011.7, and wind stays 0.

So it is not a slow drift and it is not really the charge level: the temperature and humidity sensor drops out and comes back within minutes, while the rest of the station keeps reporting perfectly. That is an intermittent failure on the sensor side, most often the sensor itself or its connection to the board, and it also explains the 30 second timeout when the app asks for a diagnosis.

That changes my earlier advice: you do not need to wait for a full charge, the test is already answered. Thank you for the patience with it.

One last check and it is a software one, so I have to rule it out: open Device Details, tap About, and send me that screen so I can see whether a firmware update is offered for 25.02266. If one is offered, run it with the charger connected and let me know whether the dropouts continue afterwards.
